findings: Pricing copy, evidence cards, plan states, controls, and hierarchy remain readable at 1440×1000 and 390×844 in dark and light themes.
The first mobile auth capture exposed a clipped final disclosure because the dialog had no bounded internal scrolling.
The first light-theme auth capture exposed module-scope palette snapshots that left the form body dark and materially reduced contrast.
After repair, the auth dialog is bounded to the dynamic viewport, scrolls to its final disclosure, and uses the active palette across the entire surface.
The actual scanner route renders BETA/SETUP PENDING in both themes and viewport classes; it does not present provider coverage or refresh cadence as live.
fixesApplied: Added a 100dvh-aware, overscroll-contained internal scroll surface to the account dialog.
Replaced module-load palette snapshots with render-time panel and input styles so theme changes update every auth surface.
Removed local analytics beacon noise by loading the production beacon only on the production hostname.
Replaced stale competitor-price framing in the global header and scanner upgrade state with capability-gated, provider-neutral language.
